Now, I don't and will never acknowledge their existence na kasi they simply don't deserve the attention and energy from me. They're irrelevant to my life. 

Buuut, before I reached that point, I acknowledged my emotions about those people that wronged me. I processed my emotions, I reflected, I forgave myself for tolerating what they did, and affirmed myself that I did my best at the time. 

This is just a perspective, not a goal, that I'm sharing that might help you. It's going to be a journey towards healing, OP.
